notes.title: Development Continues
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223498/d04f4fe60a90d9ab38fb764ad71c8b8e71b34b7c.png[/img]

I'd like to take a second to inform everyone what's been going on with Memories.

First, I'd like to apologize to everyone who's been waiting, I know its frustrating and I'm sure all of you are excited to see updates and a possible release. What I can say right now is release is over the horizon, it's still out of reach [i]*for now*[/i] but it's definitely in the sights.

As for development, I've begun working on major updates and environment variables. What this means is that the game is back on tracks for release, I've been able to find time to continue development and hope to bring a proper release date very soon!
While I am continuing to work on the game, a release date has been rolling around in my head for some time, a simple answer as for a release date, I'm not sure yet. The game still has some major features being worked on as well as story development, the skeleton and structure for the story, environment and features are there, they are still being crafted into fully fledged assets. I would hate for a release date to be announced and then need to push it back due to an unforeseen hangup that needs to be fixed.


In conclusion, I'M BACK! I hope to see some growth in both the game and community, I have some very spooky plans in mind and hope to satisfy the horror fiends across Steam!

notes.title: Delayed Development
notes.content:
Sadly development has been delayed due to numerous reasons, its very difficult doing all of this by myself with life on top of that.

Not to worry as I still plan on finishing the game and releasing it, it'll just take longer than I had expected. I apologize for not being active in the community hub, I've been quite busy with different things in my life. Development will be on hold until I can find the time to get back into the swing of things, thanks for waiting on me and I appreciate the feedback!

notes.title: Updates on development.
notes.content:
I'm glad to say that development on Memories has continued after it had ended for a short period of time. Due to an unforeseen error in my machines, I had lost the source to the project, however it has been recovered and development has continued!

I am reworking the player mechanics and scare mechanics, there will be an update to the Steam Depot as soon as some of the jumpscares and mechanics have been updated.

notes.title: New Opening!
notes.content:
I'm proud to announce the release of the Steam store page!

We've finally done it, the release of the store page is one milestone of many to get this studio off the ground. We welcome everyone to wishlist the game if they find it enjoyable from what's seen on the store page, we've worked very hard to get this out there and hope its up to everyone's expectations!

Thanks for being here, Niverean Studios.
